addr: 2545 A and B Parsonage Road A
remarks:
Private Retreat situated on 3.8 acres with superior quality woodwork and craftsmanship throughout the entire complex. 
2545 A is a 1.5 story Timberline Sequoia Redwood Lodge located on awoodland setting with 3 or 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. 8 rooms including appliances only(As Is). Finished lower level and single car garage. Living room has cathedral ceiling with a gas burning fireplace and hardwood floors. Sitting room has hardwood floors with stained glass windows. Dining room with marbled top island, hardwood floors, and 2 handmade doors that hide the pantry with swing out shelving, wine refrigerator and media center. Kitchen has granite countertops, built in appliances, and eat in countertop with stools with hardwood floors. Primary bedroom on suite with hardwood floors, 2 built in closets, sitting room and small deck. Master bathroom with tile floors, walk in shower, vanity with 2 sinks with granite countertop and jacuzzi tub. Dressing room with built in closets, drawers and shoe closet. Full bedroom on first floor is attached to full bath, hardwood floors and granite countertops. Full bathroom on first floor with granite countertop and hardwood floor. First floor laundry. Loft with hardwood floors, skylight, and stain glassed windows. Basement has 3 outside entrances. Large walk in area with closets. Rec room off main entrance. Also with utility and large storage room. Incredible amount of storage throughout. Heated Mud room in basement. Roof is asphalt and metal. Room measurements are first list from kitchen to other 4.
2545 B is a 1.5 story Timberline Sequoia Redwood A-Frame on a mature woods in a private setting with 3 bedrooms and 1 full and 2-3/4 bathrooms. 6 rooms that are fully furnished(As Is). Single car attached garage with space to store 2 cars in line. First floor includes glass enclosed area off kitchen, dining room, family room, bathroom and 2 bedrooms. Second floor with loft bedroom and bathroom. Ground level with basement, bathroom, attached garage and entrance porch. Roof is steel. Room measurements start at the second kitchen. 
Virtual tour first link is the Main house, second link is the A-Frame.
